items.title: Only two days out from GTA 6, its publisher Take-Two lay off staff at XCOM and Civilization developer Firaxis
items.en_title: Only two days out from GTA 6, its publisher Take-Two lay off staff at XCOM and Civilization developer Firaxis
items.en_oneliner: Take-Two is laying off staff at Firaxis, the studio behind Civilization and XCOM, just two days before the launch of GTA 6 and a little over a year after the studio's last round of cuts.

items.en_title: Jensen Huang would come back as Nvidia's CEO if America needs him – a technique I now intend to use at my next job interview
items.en_oneliner: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says he would be honored to return as CEO if America needs him, as speculation about a comeback continues.

items.title: Hand Tracking vs Controllers in VR: How to Choose
items.en_title: Hand Tracking vs Controllers in VR: How to Choose
items.en_oneliner: Choose controllers when a VR game needs precision, buttons and haptic feedback, and hand tracking when ease of use matters more, such as training, casual play and public demos.

items.title: Building a game like Wordle in 2026? Five ways indie developers changed the formula
items.en_title: Building a game like Wordle in 2026? Five ways indie developers changed the formula
items.en_oneliner: Independent developers stopped cloning Wordle and instead each changed one rule — word length, hidden word count, input method, shared board or story framing — to make their own variant.

items.title: Designing a browser game older players can start in ten seconds: what the classics get right
items.en_title: Designing a browser game older players can start in ten seconds: what the classics get right
items.en_oneliner: Classic card, board and puzzle games need no tutorial, never punish slow reactions and allow undoing a mistake — design choices any browser game can borrow.

items.title: Sony defeat $2.6 billion UK class action lawsuit which argued PlayStation's dominant market position fuels "excessive and unfair" game prices
items.en_title: Sony defeat $2.6 billion UK class action lawsuit which argued PlayStation's dominant market position fuels "excessive and unfair" game prices
items.en_oneliner: Sony has defeated the $2.6bn UK class action that accused it of using the PlayStation Store's dominant position to drive up digital game prices.

items.title: "Pressure To Go For The Cheaper Option Grows" - XSEED Reckons Game-Key Cards Are Here To Stay
items.en_title: "Pressure To Go For The Cheaper Option Grows" - XSEED Reckons Game-Key Cards Are Here To Stay
items.en_oneliner: As Switch 2's first year fills up with Game-Key Card releases, XSEED has stuck to complete-on-card editions — but with Nintendo's smaller cart option, will publishers drift toward the cheaper key-card route?

items.title: PlayStation defeats £2 billion UK lawsuit that alleged Sony forced consumers into "excessive and unfair prices"
items.en_title: PlayStation defeats £2 billion UK lawsuit that alleged Sony forced consumers into "excessive and unfair prices"
items.en_oneliner: After a 30-day tribunal, a UK court has dismissed the £2bn class action over PlayStation Store pricing, ruling in Sony's favour.

items.title: Meet the company that finds Chinese game developers to work on Western IP
items.en_title: Meet the company that finds Chinese game developers to work on Western IP
items.en_oneliner: Yodo1 has partnered with AMC to find and support Chinese game developers for Western TV IP like The Walking Dead — a look at what this cross-border model means for indie teams.

items.title: Are the new wave of solo AI game-makers making any money? No, not really
items.en_title: Are the new wave of solo AI game-makers making any money? No, not really
items.en_oneliner: Games built with AI tools like Claude Code are flooding the app stores, but very few are earning meaningful revenue or downloads — a sober look at solo AI game-making.

items.title: Unity Announce Fellowship + Acquire Synty Studios
items.en_title: Unity Announce Fellowship + Acquire Synty Studios
items.en_oneliner: Unity announced two moves at Unite Tokyo: a Fellowship giving 10 indie developers $50,000 each, and the acquisition of low-poly asset maker Synty Studios.

items.title: UK tribunal dismisses £2bn PlayStation class-action suit which alleged unfair pricing over 30% cut on PlayStation Store
items.en_title: UK tribunal dismisses £2bn PlayStation class-action suit which alleged unfair pricing over 30% cut on PlayStation Store
items.en_oneliner: A UK tribunal has dismissed the £2bn class action accusing Sony of unfair pricing through the PlayStation Store's 30% cut, closing — for now — a long-running fight over platform fees.
